⭐ Back by Popular Demand · Summer 2027 ⭐
We're Back at
Covenant College

Our overnight camp is returning to the mountaintop — a historic 1930s Tudor-Gothic campus perched atop Lookout Mountain, just 15 minutes from Chattanooga. Same elite training, same lifelong friendships, back at the setting campers love most.

🏰
Historic Castle Campus Train against the backdrop of an iconic Tudor-Gothic landmark
🏔
Atop Lookout Mountain Cool mountain air and sweeping valley views all week long
🏊
Resort-Style Amenities Pool, dining hall & modern residence halls on campus
🌲
Distraction-Free Focus A true mountaintop retreat built for full immersion in the game

⭐ A fan-favorite location returns — campers and families have asked for it, and we're bringing it back for 2027.
